old_problem: DeepSeek replaced the source syntax and omitted persistent global-state recovery; a MaxQ label alone did not prove the intended power-efficiency behavior or bounded performance effect.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA documents the source-literal MaxQ syntax and persistence. The review can parameterize the named workload and project power/performance limits while requiring exact pre-test mode restoration rather than assuming MaxP.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row349 all 18 XLSX columns and history2945.
Verified NVIDIA NVSM documentation for MaxQ syntax, persistent state and support limitations.
No power mode or workload state was changed.

test_case.test_name: Transactional NVSM MaxQ efficiency-mode transition and restoration
test_case.purpose: Set supported whole-system MaxQ once, prove its requested persistent mode and approved power/performance behavior, then restore the exact captured baseline.
required_package: Pinned NVSM/DGX OS/BMC versions and MaxQ capability proof
Named controlled workload and signed power/performance limits
OOB access and baseline-mode recovery plan
test_case.test_command: After explicit approval, capture `nvsm show powermode`, workload and power baselines; execute `nvsm set powermode=maxq` once, verify mode plus approved power/performance behavior, then restore the captured original mode and verify final services/health.
test_case.expected_result: The system supports MaxQ, one set succeeds, readback and measured indicators meet the approved efficiency/performance envelope without health events, and the exact original mode is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires mode, power and bounded-performance evidence plus verified restoration; the displayed string or lower power without the declared workload cannot pass.
safety_gate: Explicit approval for persistent global mode change
Abort on service, thermal, XID, AER or management anomaly; no automatic retry
test_case.recovery: Stop the controlled workload on anomaly, use OOB if necessary, restore the captured original power mode, verify management/OS/GPU health, and retain all evidence without retry.

source_conflict.reason: Official documentation validates the source command; the Review layer rejects DeepSeek's alternative syntax and supplies exact baseline recovery.
